title: PrjDelPreflightAssessment
description: DGRF Pre-Flight Execution Risk Readiness Schema for Phase 0 / Inception (Dimensions P1 - P5)

projectId.description: Unique identifier for the project evaluated

p1_schedule_estimation.title: P1: Estimation Rigor & Schedule Baseline Feasibility
p1_schedule_estimation.description: Empirical estimation methodology vs arbitrary executive deadline mandate (Max 25 pts). 3: Bottom-up probabilistic estimation (Monte Carlo / Reference Class Forecasting). 10: Parametric estimation with historical organizational benchmarks. 18: Expert consensus with aggressive timeline compression. 25: Fixed arbitrary target date mandated top-down without technical viability review.

p2_acceptance_definition.title: P2: Acceptance Definition & Verification Testability
p2_acceptance_definition.description: Clarity of 'Definition of Done', measurable SLAs, and test harness availability (Max 20 pts). 3: Quantified acceptance criteria signed off with automated test environments ready. 8: Detailed requirements with agreed manual test scenarios. 14: Vague requirement statements; ambiguous business validation mechanisms. 20: No acceptance criteria defined; success criteria entirely undefined.

p3_capital_runway.title: P3: Capital Runway & Budget Adequacy
p3_capital_runway.description: Funding certainty, runway through minimum viable release, and contingency reserves (Max 20 pts). 3: Fully committed budget through MVP + 20% dedicated buffer. 8: Budget committed for phase 1; subsequent tranches contingent on gate review. 14: Underfunded baseline relying on future unconfirmed capital allocations. 20: Speculative funding with structural cash shortfall within 60 days.

p4_team_readiness.title: P4: Core Team Capability & Onboarding Readiness
p4_team_readiness.description: Technical domain expertise, dedicated staffing ratios, and tooling readiness (Max 15 pts). 2: Dedicated, seasoned core engineering team with proven stack expertise. 6: Adequate internal team with minimal ramp-up curve needed. 11: Heavy reliance on unvetted contractors; key architecture roles unstaffed. 15: Critical skills deficit across architecture, security, and infrastructure.

p5_reporting_governance.title: P5: Operational Metrics Baseline & Instrumentation
p5_reporting_governance.description: Observability, CI/CD telemetry, and objective progress tracking tooling (Max 20 pts). 3: Automated telemetry, DORA metrics pipeline, and transparent burndown instrumentation. 8: Standard PMO ticketing and milestone tracking tools configured. 14: Manual, retrospective spreadsheet reporting with delayed cadences. 20: No delivery instrumentation; relies solely on subjective narrative updates.
